name: context-bar
description: Your context window as a stacked bar, a color per category, with token counts and the compaction point. Above the prompt, under it or in a pane (the position option). /context-bar shows or hides it.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the bar is drawn: above (boxed bar above the prompt), below (one line under the prompt) or pane (a sidebar in fullscreen mode, a full view otherwise)

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: Show the legend lines under the boxed bar (above and pane)
